applicability: Every model, configuration field and package export that served the retired installed-skill copy.
conditions: A removed surface has no surviving consumer.
Retained runtime configuration keeps the fields its live readers use.
The certification profile declares no obsolete generated-copy output: the retired renderer declarations are gone and the legitimate harness hook, MCP and rules scopes stay declared.

statement: Retired installed-skill contracts have no dead model/configuration/export surface or implied installed-copy authority without a surviving product operation.
